item.text:
### (a) Social posts

1. We need to be clear: if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will cause a catastrophe that kills at least a billion people. Preventing its development is an urgent global priority.

2. We reject the race to build superintelligent AI. If it is created within the next 20 years, at least a billion people will die in the resulting catastrophe. No promised benefit can justify that outcome.

3. We must stop superintelligent AI before it is built. Its development within the next 20 years will cause a catastrophe killing at least a billion people. We need enforceable limits and international action now.

### (b) Newsletter opening

We need to say this plainly: if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will cause a catastrophe that kills at least a billion people. We refuse to treat that outcome as a remote possibility, a plot device, or an acceptable price of technological progress. The systems now being pursued will surpass human control while holding extraordinary power over infrastructure, weapons, economies, and information. That combination is deadly. We are calling for action equal to the danger: enforceable limits, rigorous oversight, and an international commitment not to build superintelligent AI. The window to prevent catastrophe is open now. We must use it before the decisions of a few endanger billions.
